definition.observe: bridge_observe runs observe on the raw input and then bridge_express on the same raw input; it returns the new state and info with a bridge_expression entry
definition.twenty: the 20 describe sentences must produce the expected pair texts
definition.trajectory: the bridged tensor trajectory must be bit-identical to a plain observe run
definition.unknown: an unknown input clears last_bridge_text through no_pair
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.twenty: 20/20 expression decisions are chosen_pair and 20/20 texts are exact
criteria.trajectory: 20/20 state hashes equal to the plain run; final state hash equal
criteria.parameters: parameter hash equal before and after; table digest unchanged
criteria.unknown: unknown expression is no_pair and last_bridge_text is None; tensors equal to plain
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal before and after
criteria.rerun: the R30 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256
